run_end2end_qa: run end-to-end multi-hop QA evaluation using a HNSW index and a RobertaRetriever on a JSON dataset
run_hnsw_retrieval: run two-hop dense retrieval with a FAISS HNSW index and aggregate chain scores for top-k paths
run_qa_reading: run the QA reader model on retrieved candidate document chains and compute exact match and F1 scores
run_convert_hnsw_query: run convert_hnsw_query to append an auxiliary zero dimension to query vectors for HNSW index compatibility
run_eval_final: run eval_final to evaluate the QA reader model on a dataloader of retrieved candidate chains
